title: Hope Amid Destruction
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-03-08

Opens [2 Kgs 19](/bible/2-kings/19) · [Isa 33](/bible/isaiah/33) · [Isa 34](/bible/isaiah/34)
## Introduction *[[11:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=692s)]* A Sabbath class in Philadelphia, Hope Amid Destruction, teaching Isaiah 33 verse by verse against the war with Iran. It opens with Hezekiah spreading Sennacherib's letter before the Lord and one angel killing 185,000 Assyrians, then shows the scripture is double: the spoiler who was not spoiled is Assyria then and America now, robbing Venezuela, Libya, Iraq, and Iran and dealing treacherously in the ceasefire talks. Through the chapter the Bishop reads the birthing pains, the Lord rising in Zion, wisdom and knowledge as the stability of our times, the ambassadors of peace weeping, Lebanon and Tel Aviv laid waste, the hypocrites in Zion, and the hope: who walks righteously shall see the King in his beauty, Jerusalem a tabernacle never taken down, no inhabitant saying I am sick, and the whole book of the Lord possessed for ever. ## In The News - *[[15:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=922s)]* **The Hope Amid Destruction thumbnail animation.** — Shout out to the art department. A thumbnail like that puts the spirit on you when you wake up with no motivation. - *[[41:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=2479s)]* **George Galloway: Israel is taking a hiding you do not see, because releasing footage of damage in Tel Aviv brings five years in prison and CNN, BBC, and Sky accept Israeli censorship; his friends on Sheinkin Street say Tel Aviv looks like Gaza with the air defences down, fifty ballistic missiles in one evening, and American dead approaching a thousand.** — Habakkuk 2:8 in real time: all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee. - *[[43:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=2601s)]* **An Iranian official: we are not asking for a ceasefire and see no reason to negotiate, because twice they attacked us in the middle of negotiations; we are confident we can confront a ground invasion and it would be a disaster for them.** — Isaiah 33:1, dealing treacherously. They called the ambassador to Geneva to talk ceasefire and hit Iran with Midnight Hammer; they bombed again during the second talk, and they killed the negotiator in Qatar. Invading someone's home when he knows the layout makes you a sitting duck, and they will die for what they stand for while America hides its casualties. - *[[46:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=2794s)]* **A former American military man: we have bombed two children's schools, 63 dead girls and a hundred more under the rubble, sent to school because diplomacy was under way; when I was involved in the Al-Amiriyah shelter bombing we did our damnedest to confirm a military target; you do not make those mistakes.** — The media that says Iran abuses women is bombing girls' schools. He also said, you invaded Syria, get off their land. Mind your beeswax, America. - *[[48:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=2920s)]* **A Muslim commentator on the Texas shooter said to have a property of Allah sweater, an Iranian flag shirt, and a Quran in the car: Muslims never put Allah's name where it can be dirtied; this is optics.** — It is a CIA psyop, like Yahawashi is coming written in the street after the Jersey shooting. And you Hebrew Israelites who put the Most High's name on your clothes are doing what Christians do; the Muslims treat the name as more sacred than that. - *[[1:01:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=3686s)]* **A picture of a heavy man praying at the dinner table to lose weight with a chicken leg in one hand and a steak in the other.** — God needs something to work with. Smaller portions, walk around the block, then let the Lord do the rest. Likewise you pray for wisdom with the Bible closed Sunday through Friday; give the Lord something to work with. - *[[1:19:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=4770s)]* **A report on southern Lebanon: Israeli air strikes and an advance to take more territory beyond the five outposts held since the 2024 ceasefire, dozens killed, thirty thousand displaced, a woman pleading for safety and stability, Lebanon's government banning Hezbollah's military activity, and the US embassy in Beirut shutting.** — Isaiah 33:8-9: he hath broken the covenant, that 2024 ceasefire; Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down. The woman asked for stability; wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times. Sharon is Tel Aviv, Bashan is Syria, Carmel is northern Israel; the Bishop and a deacon taught on those very streets in Tel Aviv. - *[[1:25:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=5124s)]* **Footage of strikes on Tel Aviv that CNN, BBC, and MSNBC are not showing.** — Sharon is like a wilderness. - *[[1:41:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=6064s)]* **Church clips: a pastor kissing women on the mouth as a holy kiss with holy water, an African church rolling on the floor claiming the Holy Spirit, a white preacher saying ninety to ninety-five percent of the black church is heretical and should be split up into good white churches, and an AI pastor.** — Isaiah 33:14, fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Our people in Christianity have lost their minds, and now some Israelites speak in tongues and call it a heavenly language, Israelite Pentecostals. - *[[1:47:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=6424s)]* **A pastor at Perfecting Church reading out a member's seed of a thousand dollars plus two hundred thirty-five, and correcting her that he asked for a thousand plus a thousand, while the organ keeps playing.** — Matthew 6:2, sounding a trumpet before thee as the hypocrites do; they have their reward. The piano player went in like he agreed. - *[[1:49:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=6581s)]* **Thousands of Christians praying in the streets in California.** — Matthew 6:5, they love to pray standing in the corners of the streets to be seen of men. - *[[1:50:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=6645s)]* **A man recounts a pastor who kept a check written to the church for a widow, exposed only when the treasurer thanked the donor, and who is now pushing the widow out; his friends told him to keep his peace.** — Matthew 23:14, ye devour widows' houses and for a pretence make long prayer. The modern Pharisees are our people in Christianity. - *[[2:24:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=8670s)]* **Pictures of galleys with oars.** — Isaiah 33:21, no galley with oars nor gallant ship shall pass. Those were warships; the Lord will give us power to take down their navies and air forces. - *[[2:33:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=9222s)]* **A map showing Edom with Bozrah, modern-day Jordan.** — The Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea; all the wars take place over there. It is the controversy of Zion, and Amalek gets mad when asked for a DNA check because the DNA of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob is not on file. ## Scriptures Opened **[2 Kings 19:14-37](/bible/2-kings/19#v14)** *[[16:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=1008s)]* > [14](/bible/2-kings/19#v14) And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord. > > [15](/bible/2-kings/19#v15) And Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said, O Lord God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth. > > [16](/bible/2-kings/19#v16) Lord, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God. > > [17](/bible/2-kings/19#v17) Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands, > > [18](/bible/2-kings/19#v18) And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them. > > [19](/bible/2-kings/19#v19) Now therefore, O Lord our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord God, even thou only. > > [20](/bible/2-kings/19#v20) Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard. > > [21](/bible/2-kings/19#v21) This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee. > > [22](/bible/2-kings/19#v22) Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel. > > [23](/bible/2-kings/19#v23) By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel. > > [24](/bible/2-kings/19#v24) I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places. > > [25](/bible/2-kings/19#v25) Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps. > > [26](/bible/2-kings/19#v26) Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up. > > [27](/bible/2-kings/19#v27) But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me. > > [28](/bible/2-kings/19#v28) Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest. > > [29](/bible/2-kings/19#v29) And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof. > > [30](/bible/2-kings/19#v30) And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward. > > [31](/bible/2-kings/19#v31) For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this. > > [32](/bible/2-kings/19#v32) Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it. > > [33](/bible/2-kings/19#v33) By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord. > > [34](/bible/2-kings/19#v34) For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake. > > [35](/bible/2-kings/19#v35) And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses. > > [36](/bible/2-kings/19#v36) So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh. > > [37](/bible/2-kings/19#v37) And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead. - Assyria took the northern kingdom around 722 BC and came for Judah around 701. Hezekiah received the letter of threats, went up to the house of the Lord, spread it before him, and prayed: thou alone art God of all the kingdoms, the nations' gods were wood and stone, save us that all the earth may know thou art the Lord. Cast all your care upon him, 1 Peter 5:7. - Isaiah, who was not in the room, was sent to say I have heard. The virgin daughter of Zion hath despised thee and laughed thee to scorn. Sennacherib reproached the Holy One of Israel, boasting of cutting the tall cedars and firs, the best of us, and entering Carmel and Lebanon, which is ours and which we will take back. - I know thy abode and thy rage against me; I will put my hook in thy nose, as Assyria did to captives, and turn thee back. The remnant of Judah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward; out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant. He shall not come into this city nor shoot an arrow, for I will defend it for mine own sake and my servant David's sake, not for Judah's. - That night one angel smote 185,000 Assyrians, dead corpses in the morning. Sennacherib was left alive to bear witness, went home to Nineveh, and his own sons killed him in his god's house; Tobit continues the story. - Rabshakeh had cried in the Jews' language: let not Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord; make an agreement with me by a present and I will carry you to a land like your own; which of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of my hand? The people held their peace at the king's commandment. Precepts: - **[1 Peter 5:7](/bible/1-peter/5#v7)** > [7](/bible/1-peter/5#v7) Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you. Casting all your care upon him, for he careth for you. Go before the Lord and spread the problem out as Hezekiah did. - **[Matthew 12:36](/bible/matthew/12#v36)** > [36](/bible/matthew/12#v36) But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment. Every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment. Idle means idolatrous; the Most High records everything. - **[Job 11:6](/bible/job/11#v6)** > [6](/bible/job/11#v6) And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth. The secrets of wisdom are double to that which is. Christian commentaries put Isaiah 33 entirely in Hezekiah's past so the apologists can say it already happened; the scripture has a double meaning. **[Isaiah 33:1](/bible/isaiah/33#v1)** *[[32:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=1955s)]* > [1](/bible/isaiah/33#v1) Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. - Woe to thee that spoilest and thou wast not spoiled, and dealest treacherously and they dealt not treacherously with thee. Assyria then; the United States now. Spoil means rob: Venezuela's oil, now controlled, with Cuba's electricity cut for two weeks and the babies in incubators dead; Gaddafi's riches; Saddam's wealth; Iran. None of them did anything to America. - When thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled, and when thou makest an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. God will let the nations rise up. Precepts: - **[Habakkuk 2:5-8](/bible/habakkuk/2#v5)** > [5](/bible/habakkuk/2#v5) Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people: > > [6](/bible/habakkuk/2#v6) Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay! > > [7](/bible/habakkuk/2#v7) Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them? > > [8](/bible/habakkuk/2#v8) Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein. He transgresseth by wine, his philosophies and policies (Micah 2:11, prophesying of wine and strong drink is the spirit of falsehood); he is a proud man, none prouder than Trump; keepeth not at home but is in Venezuela and Iran; enlargeth his desire as hell, and wherever he sets up democracy the place goes to hell; is as death and cannot be satisfied, now wanting Greenland and Canada; and gathereth unto him all nations, the melting pot. Shall not all these, the remnants from the destabilized countries living here, take up a taunting proverb: woe to him that increaseth that which is not his, how long? He seized Russia's boats and wealth too. Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, sleeper cells from Nigeria, Somalia, Yemen, and Iran, because thou hast spoiled many nations, because of men's blood. Bomb a school of five-to-ten-year-old girls and their fathers and cousins here will not let bygones be bygones; that is how you make a terrorist. - **[Micah 2:11](/bible/micah/2#v11)** > [11](/bible/micah/2#v11) If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying I will prophesy unto thee of wine and strong drink, he shall even be the prophet of this people. Wine is the metaphor for the spirit of falsehood and lies. - **[1 Thessalonians 5:3](/bible/1-thessalonians/5#v3)** > [3](/bible/1-thessalonians/5#v3) For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape. When they shall say peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child, and they shall not escape. When they think they have subdued the earth, it comes; birthing pains, one thing today, another in two or three months or years. - **[Job 20:22-23](/bible/job/20#v22)** > [22](/bible/job/20#v22) In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. > > [23](/bible/job/20#v23) When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating. In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; every hand of the wicked shall come upon him, as Habakkuk 2 and Revelation 17 when NATO turns; when he is about to fill his belly God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him and rain it upon him while he is eating. Same as Thessalonians. They try to make us the bad guys, but the real bad guys are written in the Bible, and their friends will turn on them. **[Isaiah 33:2-6](/bible/isaiah/33#v2)** *[[54:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHlrm-QsbBM&t=3257s)]* > [2](/bible/isaiah/33#v2) O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble. > > [3](/bible/isaiah/33#v3) At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered. > > [4](/bible/isaiah/33#v4) And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them. > > [5](/bible/isaiah/33#v5) The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness. > > [6](/bible/isaiah/33#v6) And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure. - O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: our prayer, like Hezekiah's. Be thou their arm every morning, our men who go out to battle, our salvation in the time of trouble. At the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered and the spoil gathered like the caterpillar. - The Lord is exalted; he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness through Christ, the righteous Branch of Jeremiah 23:5 who executes judgment and justice in the earth. Glory in this, that thou understandest and knowest me, Jeremiah 9:24. - Wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation; the fear of the Lord is his treasure. The wisdom of this Bible keeps us mentally and spiritually stable, against Deuteronomy 28:28, madness, blindness, and astonishment of heart. Our people are shocked at everything going on; we are not, because the Bible said it. - The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, Sirach 19:20, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law: be about it, not just talk about it. If you do not fear the Lord, that is where your problems are. Precepts: - **[Jeremiah 9:24](/bible/jeremiah/9#v24)** > [24](/bible/jeremiah/9#v24) But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord. Let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness in the earth. - **[Jeremiah 23:5](/bible/jeremiah/23#v5)** > [5](/bible/jeremiah/23#v5) Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth. I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, Christ, and a King shall reign and prosper and execute judgment and justice in the earth. - **[Deuteronomy 28:28](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v28)** > [28](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v28) The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, blindness, and astonishment of heart. Our people are mentally unstable and spiritually blind, always shocked at the world. - **[Sirach 19:20](/bible/sirach/19#v20)** > [20](/bible/sirach/19#v20) The fear of the Lord is all wisdom; and in all wisdom is the performance of the law, and the knowledge of his omnipotency. The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law, and the knowledge of his omnipotency. - **[2 Peter 2:14](/bible/2-peter/2#v14)** > [14](/bible/2-peter/2#v14) Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children: Having eyes full of adultery, that cannot cease from sin, beguiling unstable souls, cursed children. The flip side of stability: a mind not saturated with the word. We all have children we train up, and Samuel's went to hell; you will find out which spirits serve the Lord. - **[James 1:5-9](/bible/james/1#v5)** > [5](/bible/james/1#v5) If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him. > > [6](/bible/james/1#v6) But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed. > > [7](/bible/james/1#v7) For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord. > > [8](/bible/james/1#v8) A double minded man is unstable in all his ways. > > [9](/bible/james/1#v9) Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, in faith, nothing wavering; a double-minded man is unstable in all his ways. Some cannot discern why an adulterer was put out of the school. Pray for wisdom and discernment, but give the Lord something to work with: 2 Esdras 14:40, when Ezra drank, wisdom grew and his spirit strengthened his memory, because the Spirit needed a memory to access to rewrite the books. If the Bible is closed six days a week there is nothing in there for the Spirit to bring to mind. Views peak on Sabbath and nobody watches the rest of the week, the same as Christians on Sunday; many are called, few are chosen. Let the brother of low degree rejoice that he is exalted: the quiet brother who studies and prays becomes the one breaking down scripture years later. Sirach 11:12, the slow man wanting ability, the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good and set him up from his low estate. Put on Bible audio at night if reading hurts your eyes. - **[2 Esdras 14:40](/bible/2-esdras/14#v40)** > [40](/bible/2-esdras/14#v40) And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory: I took it and drank, and my heart uttered understanding, wisdom grew in my breast, and my spirit strengthened my memory. - **[Sirach 11:12](/bible/sirach/11#v12)** > [12](/bible/sirach/11#v12) Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate, There is another that is slow, wanting ability and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good and set him up from his low estate and lifted up his head from misery, so that many marvelled. - **[Luke 21:24-28](/bible/luke/21#v24)** > [24](/bible/luke/21#v24) And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. > > [25](/bible/luke/21#v25) And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring; > > [26](/bible/luke/21#v26) Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken. > > [27](/bible/luke/21#v27) And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory. > > [28](/bible/luke/21#v28) And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh. Signs in the sun, moon, and stars, blood moons and eclipses; distress of nations with perplexity, confusion: they say Venezuela was drug dealers and Iraq had weapons of mass destruction, but Maduro, Gaddafi, and Iran sold oil outside the dollar; when white people say it is complex, it is simple and they do not want you to know. Men's hearts failing them for fear, but not us, because wisdom is our stability; the powers of heaven, America, England, France, Germany, shall be shaken; then the Son of man in a cloud. Look up, for your redemption draweth nigh.
